column1: # The scenarios that check a function's result: where the function list says
# it shows (at the provider, in what the service returns), not merely that
# the request was accepted. A function is claimed on a provider when one of
# these scenarios passed on an inbox of that provider and its record shows it
# <test>`, as nextest prints it. A row whose scenario no longer performs the
# function is reported as stale. It is covered only when proofs.tsv also names
# a break in product code that made the scenario fail on that provider.
